extracted.name: Easiest Applesauce Cake
extracted.description: This moist spice cake starts with a simple cake mix with applesauce added in. It makes a wonderful breakfast or snack cake with tea. This is the easiest recipe.
ingredient_lines: 1 (3.4 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C). Grease and flour three 8x4-inch loaf pans.

In a large bowl, stir together cake mix, instant pudding mix, nutmeg, and cinnamon. Add applesauce, oil, eggs, and water. Blend for 3 to 4 minutes using an electric mixer. Divide the batter evenly between the prepared pans.
Bake for 50 to 55 minutes in the preheated oven, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
